telegram.title: Gonzales
telegram.name: Gonzales
telegram.why: C# phrygian bass with rests on 4 and 6. An electro 3-3-2 stab rhythm on C# starts in the first gap; the phrygian D falls back to C# at the end.

telegram.title: Goliad
telegram.name: Goliad
telegram.why: The bass circles C with a C# and F# underneath. A 3-3-2 stab on C leans on the flat second and drops to G at the end: early electro, nothing more.

telegram.title: Six Flags
telegram.name: Six Flags
telegram.why: The bass leaves steps 4 and 8 open. The lead takes the first gap with the country-funk blue note, Eb rising to E, then climbs to C.

telegram.title: Republic
telegram.name: Republic
telegram.why: F# major bass that never rests. A machine-pop line climbs C#, D#, F# against it, then the leading note F turns back to F# and steps down home. Rewritten after Joe heard the robot-octave version.

telegram.title: Texian
telegram.name: Texian
telegram.why: The bass pounds F and C, with one rest at step 11. The lead waits for it: a double minor-third stab, then home to F.

telegram.title: Tejano
telegram.name: Tejano
telegram.why: Bass on G, C and F#. A chicken-picked repeat on D, the fifth, falling to B and G.

telegram.title: Juneteenth
telegram.name: Big Thicket
telegram.why: Db major bass, centred on Ab. Chicken-picked Ab repeats walk up the chord to Eb, then step back down to Ab. Renamed and rewritten after Joe heard the first version.

telegram.title: Spindletop
telegram.name: Spindletop
telegram.why: The bass sits hard on C#. A 3-3-2 octave figure and a flat-seventh B turnaround.

telegram.title: Comancheria
telegram.name: Comancheria
telegram.why: F bass with both A and Eb. The blue-note step Ab to A, then F, C and back to A.

telegram.title: Fort Concho
telegram.name: Fort Concho
telegram.why: B minor bass with chromatic passing notes. A 3-3-2 stab on B rises through the minor third to E and falls back to B. Rewritten after Joe heard the first version.

telegram.title: Fort Griffin
telegram.name: Fort Griffin
telegram.why: The bass moves Eb-F-D-Bb. Robot Bb stabs in 3-3-2 jump the octave, then F and D outline the chord.

telegram.title: Chisholm
telegram.name: Chisholm
telegram.why: The bass rests on steps 4, 6 and 16. The lead plays only there: G, Bb, and a high C on the last step.

telegram.title: Goodnight
telegram.name: Goodnight
telegram.why: Ab and Db bass. A repeated F, then Eb held, settling on Db.

telegram.title: El Capitan
telegram.name: El Capitan
telegram.why: A busy, sliding A-to-Eb tritone bass. A robot octave figure on A states the root twice and leaves space, then a held Eb answers the bass's tritone.

telegram.title: Temple
telegram.name: Temple
telegram.why: Twelve steps in A dorian. A held descending hook in contrary motion to the bass's A-D-E-G climb, ending on a C to C# blue-note turn.

telegram.title: Longview
telegram.name: Longview
telegram.why: Driving A then G octaves, no rests. Gritty stabs leave most steps empty: a C to C# blue-note turn over A, then D and B over the G bar.

telegram.title: Aransas
telegram.name: Aransas
telegram.why: A four-step loop of octave Es. Country-funk blue note: G to G#, minor to major third, picked staccato, then the fifth.

telegram.title: Chalk Mtn
telegram.name: Chalk Mtn
telegram.why: Sixteen Cs jumping octaves with ten slides: all rhythm, no harmony. A sustained C minor-pentatonic PWM hook supplies the harmony.

telegram.title: Esperanza
telegram.name: Esperanza
telegram.why: The Sunflower motif re-pitched to Esperanza's F, C# and E sections, so each stab sits on the bass's current root.

telegram.title: Primrose
telegram.name: Primrose
telegram.why: Twelve slides on a whole-tone F#-E-D-C descent. Brass stabs in a Planet Rock 3-3-2 rhythm (steps 3, 6, 8) trace the descent above; this rhythm is the Sunflower motif.

telegram.title: Anacacho
telegram.name: Anacacho
telegram.why: Five steps falling C#-C-G. A robot octave jump on G, then the tritone C#; it cycles against the bar line with the bass.

telegram.title: Kit Fox
telegram.name: Kit Fox
telegram.why: Eight steps on Eb. Repeated offbeat Ebs, Planet Rock style, then a falling Db-Bb answer over the Ab turnaround.

telegram.title: Gar
telegram.name: Gar
telegram.why: The bass plays only the first half-bar. The lead waits, then answers in the gap: a Db to D blue-note lick resolving to Bb.

telegram.title: Hognose
telegram.name: Hognose
telegram.why: Six steps of C with a Bb pickup. Blue-note Eb to E then the fifth, a short country-funk lick that lands before the accented low Cs.
